title: What a client may ask hpcworker
description: The command lines another program types to the lab's shared copy (docs/V11_CONTRACT.md section 4) and the lines the gate accepts as its forced command (docs/V12_CONTRACT.md 'The gate'). Everything else hpcworker takes is for people at a terminal and may change in any release. <tool> is <shared_install>/bin/hpcworker, <shared_install> the site profile's value; the two grid-gate lines are a lab lead's and run from the lab lead's own clone instead. A value is checked against its pattern before it is placed; a client never quotes around a bad value. Outputs are read through lines.json and the schemas.

login.note: fresh is refused: HPCW-STEP failed usage, exit 2

clone.note: the lab lead's own clone of OpenSpineConsortium/hpcworker, a folder under the home; no part begins with a dot, so never ..

commands.stdin: the pasted code, once, after the code-prompt line

commands.note: typed by the student in their own terminal, never by a client's own shell

commands.line: cd "$HOME"/'<clone>' && git checkout -q main && GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -o BatchMode=yes' git pull -q --ff-only && bash tools/grid_runner.sh --gate-setup --repo '<repo>' --site '<site>'
commands.reads: the exit status: 0 set up and grid-gate.yml started; anything else refused or failed, the last line beginning grid_runner: says why, or, where it says only that nothing was changed, the line before it does (a public repository, gh unable to read it)
commands.note: a lab lead's tool, pressed by a person: the pull asks nothing at the terminal (no HTTPS prompt, ssh in batch mode), since the line runs with a terminal on stdin; it runs from the lab lead's own clone, which the ssh gate's forced command runs from (README.md, A GitHub Actions runner on the grid), never from the shared copy

commands.reads: the exit status: 0 the line is out, or was not there
commands.note: takes the gate's line for the repository out of ~/.ssh/authorized_keys; the secret stays at GitHub until it is deleted there

gate.description: SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND, exactly one of these lines; anything else: HPCW-GATE refused, exit 126

verbs.reads: lines.json step family; never signin (the gate runs --login never)
the file's bytes; progress.log's last 256 KB
lines.json key family: forgotten, none or stuck
